capability_catalog_full.description: Persist a typed AI-world cognition using the unified EvidenceSet + Claim + Dependency path.

capability_catalog_full.description: Persist a revisable AI cognition Claim grounded in pinned world evidence. This capability cannot create Observation facts.
capability_catalog_full.name: commit_claim

capability_catalog_full.description: During an active periodic review, persist a model-authored operation experience grounded in pinned real case refs.
capability_catalog_full.name: commit_operation_experience

capability_catalog_full.description: Inspect multiple pinned Claims side by side with their evidence/status; the model decides meaning.
capability_catalog_full.name: compare_claims

capability_catalog_full.description: Create a concrete evidence-grounded Task, optionally under a current Goal.
capability_catalog_full.name: create_task

capability_catalog_full.description: Read exact pinned raw dialogue behind a same-session round summary, or an explicit turn range. Round summaries are indexes, not truth.

capability_catalog_full.description: Request a broader bounded world recall after the initial recommendation/search was insufficient.

capability_catalog_full.description: Focus retrieval on one known Entity id without semantic reinterpretation.

capability_catalog_full.description: Follow one-hop explicit Relation objects connected to a world object.

capability_catalog_full.description: Inspect a pinned real Action Outcome and its Action reference.

capability_catalog_full.description: Read one pinned or latest world object by object id.

capability_catalog_full.description: List current registered dimension definitions so the resident AI can check whether an existing observation axis already serves the need.

capability_catalog_full.name: propose_action

capability_catalog_full.description: Register a new evidence-grounded AI-mutable cognitive policy. Only real user/world result evidence is accepted; hard boundaries cannot be created by the resident AI.

capability_catalog_full.description: Submit an evidence-grounded candidate observation axis. The system validates structure; the model supplies semantic rationale.
capability_catalog_full.name: propose_dimension

capability_catalog_full.name: propose_entity

capability_catalog_full.description: Create an evidence-grounded Goal proposal in the unified world. A proposal does not grant external-action authorization.
capability_catalog_full.name: propose_goal

capability_catalog_full.description: Read current evidence-grounded AI cognition across user understanding, relationship, self, intent, strategy, boundary, personality and calibration.
capability_catalog_full.name: read_ai_world

capability_catalog_full.description: Read current versioned R6 policy records from the unified world.
capability_catalog_full.name: read_cognitive_policies

capability_catalog_full.description: Read current Goals, Tasks and proposed/executed Actions from the unified world. This is a read-only planning view.
capability_catalog_full.name: read_execution_world

capability_catalog_full.description: Read a bounded page of the evidence anchors selected for the currently active periodic review. Available only during review.
capability_catalog_full.name: read_periodic_review_anchors

capability_catalog_full.description: Record what communication style was used and the real user/world reaction. This records evidence only and does not choose a future style.
capability_catalog_full.name: record_communication_experience

capability_catalog_full.description: Observe several parallel dimensions in one time window without turning co-occurrence into a causal conclusion.
capability_catalog_full.name: request_all_dimensions_projection

capability_catalog_full.description: Retract the current Claim using pinned contrary/correcting evidence and propagate review-required state to dependents.
capability_catalog_full.name: retract_claim

capability_catalog_full.description: Retrieve an exact Observation fact by id/revision for evidence drill-down.
capability_catalog_full.name: retrieve_original_observation

capability_catalog_full.description: Create a forward-only new revision of the current Claim and mark dependent cognition review-required.
capability_catalog_full.name: revise_claim

capability_catalog_full.description: Append a new revision of the current Entity identity anchor using pinned evidence.
capability_catalog_full.name: revise_entity

capability_catalog_full.description: Forward-append a rollback to an earlier policy version using pinned evidence.
capability_catalog_full.name: rollback_cognitive_policy

capability_catalog_full.description: Search same-session round-summary indexes by topic/text, then drill down to exact pinned raw dialogue when precision is needed.
capability_catalog_full.name: search_conversation_summaries

capability_catalog_full.description: Search the world inside an explicit time window, optionally bounded by dimension/type/query.
capability_catalog_full.name: search_timeline

capability_catalog_full.description: Recall candidate world objects related to a query.
capability_catalog_full.name: search_world

capability_catalog_full.description: Move the current dimension revision through a legal lifecycle transition using pinned evidence and an AI-supplied reason.
capability_catalog_full.name: transition_dimension

capability_catalog_full.description: Forward-revise/resolve/reject/merge/split the current Event using pinned evidence.
capability_catalog_full.name: transition_event

capability_catalog_full.description: Move the current Goal revision through a legal evidence-backed state transition.
capability_catalog_full.name: transition_goal

capability_catalog_full.description: Move the current Task revision through a legal state transition. COMPLETED/FAILED requires real Outcome refs.
capability_catalog_full.name: transition_task

capability_catalog_full.description: Append an evidence-grounded value revision to an already-registered AI-mutable cognitive policy. Cannot create or loosen hard boundaries.
capability_catalog_full.name: update_cognitive_policy

capability_catalog_full.description: Create or forward-revise an evidence-grounded Relation between current Entity revisions.
capability_catalog_full.name: upsert_relation
